newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed lower across the board in moderate trade on some late local selling interest in line with weaker Japanese prices, brokers said on Wednesday.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe ended weaker as selling in nearby months pressured the market amid bearish sentiment. Bumper rubber stocks are still casting a shadow on the market.

"The morning session was quiet and featureless on lack of fresh incentives. But prices were marked down slightly in the afternoon in sympathy with weaker prices in Tokyo and Kobe. Volume was moderate," a local broker said.
